source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When one of your models uses a **[Bondsman](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.bondsman)** ability that no other model in your army has used this turn, it may affect as many as three of your **ARMIGER** models rather than one. They must be within 12" of the user, or 15" if your army is **[Honoured](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric)**, and none may already be under a Bondsman ability. The effect on them lasts until your next **[Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase)** starts.
